rules_evaluated.evidence: "fires"/"fire" recurs in chunks 0, 3, 4 describing when a CLAUDE.md rule activates ("so it fires when you want it"; "The choice is when the rules fire"; "actually fire"). Cross-checked: this is established AE101-wide technical vocabulary for rule/hook/verifier/skill activation, not maintainer-authoring dialect — e.g. composing-the-workflow.md:163 ("A rule in ./CLAUDE.md fires a move"), spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md:90 ("The verifier fires on output; the gap-finder fires before"), the-loop-has-a-name.md:14 ("The shape fires on any workflow with a quality bar"), diagnose-and-resend.md:47/61. Falls under the ordinary-engineering-verb carve-out (compendium's own example: "surface" as engineering verb), distinct from the maintainer's compendium-firing sense in content-rules.md. No other dialect terms (compendium, beat, mood, forcing function, surface-as-noun, Connections) appear in the body.
